description: Creates an empty customer dictionary for the current Maximo connection and opens it as a sheet (see open_dictionary). Kinds: alias (how the customer writes a name → the name in Maximo; used by dictionaries in match_sheets and lookups), code (words in the text → a code such as a failure problem, cause or remedy; used by classify in apply_rule), value (how a value is written → the correct value; used by replace in apply_rule). Create one only when no dictionary in get_status fits, and tell the user its name. It is kept in the connection's shared folder (shared with the project members) or, without one, on this PC.

name.description: Name the user will recognize, e.g. Equipment names or Failure words

name: create_dictionary
title: Create a customer dictionary
